runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game fg_1200ag --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --ready-timeout 90 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/family-guy-2007-dedicated-switch-sweep.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Public 81-88 are the flipper button and EOS pairs: pinned sam.c samswitch_r copies each button bit (D-9, D-11, D-13, D-15) into its EOS bit as the CPU reads the dedicated word, so the switch test names the EOS of the pair whichever bit is held; the two lower EOS bits are also rewritten by core_updateSw from the flipper coil timers. Every held write reads back 1 in this run except the slam-tilt write (-6), which reads back 0 in some runs although the frame names SLAM TILT (a host-side readback, not ROM evidence).

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted key pulses; every retained DMD frame was read visually and each diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is that reading of its pixel SHA-256. Exact external directory manifest dedicated-sweep-fg_1200ag/manifest.json SHA-256 3cc0d4cf4b9f9dafb6937b6a211450e00e9203a58aedcbda82effb29e38ea6b0 (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py); it lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
